coreMemory.chinese: 将；会；愿意；一定会；常常会；惯于；意志；决心；遗嘱
coreMemory.english: modal v. used to express a future action, event, or prediction；modal v. used to express willingness, a promise, or a decision；modal v. used to describe habitual or characteristic behavior；n. determination or mental resolve；n. a legal document stating what should happen to someone's property after death
coreMemory.structure: will have done something /ˈwɪl ˈhæv ˈdʌn ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（到将来某时已经完成某事）；will be doing something /ˈwɪl ˈbiː ˈduːɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（将正在做某事）；will not hear of something /ˈwɪl ˈnɑt hɪr ˈʌv ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（坚决不同意某事）；will do anything to do something /ˈwɪl ˈduː ˈɛniˌθɪŋ ˈtuː ˈduː ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（会不惜一切做某事）

structures.chinese: 到将来某时已经完成某事

structures.phrase: will do anything to do something

coreMemory.commonError: ❌ I promise I would call you tonight. → ✅ I promise I will call you tonight.；❌ When she will arrive, we will eat. → ✅ When she arrives, we will eat.

commonErrors.wrong: I promise I would call you tonight.
commonErrors.wrongPhonetic: /ˈaɪ ˈprɑməs ˈaɪ ˈwʊd ˈkɔːl ˈjuː təˈnaɪt/
commonErrors.right: I promise I will call you tonight.
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /ˈaɪ ˈprɑməs ˈaɪ ˈwɪl ˈkɔːl ˈjuː təˈnaɪt/
commonErrors.note: 说话当下作出的直接承诺用 will；would 常带过去视角、假设或委婉语气。

commonErrors.wrong: When she will arrive, we will eat.
commonErrors.wrongPhonetic: /ˈwɛn ˈʃiː ˈwɪl ɚˈaɪv ˈwiː ˈwɪl ˈiːt/
commonErrors.right: When she arrives, we will eat.
commonErrors.note: 表示将来的时间从句通常用一般现在时，不用 will。

coreMemory.directSynonym: be going to /ˈbiː ˈɡoʊɪŋ ˈtuː/（将要；打算）；be set to /ˈbiː ˈsɛt ˈtuː/（预计将；即将）；intend to /ˌɪnˈtɛnd ˈtuː/（打算做）；plan to /ˈplæn ˈtuː/（计划做）；be willing to /ˈbiː ˈwɪlɪŋ ˈtuː/（愿意做）
coreMemory.directAntonym: refuse to /rəˈfjuːz ˈtuː/（拒绝做）；be forced to /ˈbiː ˈfɔːrst ˈtuː/（被迫做）；lack resolve /ˈlæk riˈzɑlv/（缺乏决心）
coreMemory.example: I will review the new verbs after dinner.
coreMemory.exampleChinese: 我晚饭后会复习这些新动词。

meanings.english: used to express a future action, event, or prediction
meanings.example: The meeting will begin at nine.

meanings.english: used to express willingness, a promise, or a decision
meanings.example: I will help you with the boxes.
meanings.translation: 我愿意帮你搬这些箱子。

meanings.english: used to describe habitual or characteristic behavior
meanings.example: Children will often ask difficult questions.
meanings.translation: 孩子们常会问一些难题。

meanings.example: She has a strong will to succeed.

meanings.english: a legal document stating what should happen to someone's property after death
meanings.example: He left the house to his daughter in his will.
meanings.translation: 他在遗嘱中把房子留给了女儿。

items.phrase: will often sit here for hours
items.chinese: 常常会在这里坐数小时

fixedPhrases.chinese: 到将来某时已经完成某事
fixedPhrases.example: By Friday, we will have finished the report.
fixedPhrases.translation: 到周五我们将已经完成报告。

fixedPhrases.example: This time tomorrow, I will be flying home.
fixedPhrases.translation: 明天这个时候我将正在飞回家。

fixedPhrases.example: My parents will not hear of me leaving early.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我父母坚决不同意我提前离开。

fixedPhrases.phrase: will do anything to do something
fixedPhrases.example: He will do anything to protect his family.
fixedPhrases.translation: 他会不惜一切保护家人。

fixedPhrases.phrase: will not take no for an answer
fixedPhrases.phonetic: /ˈwɪl ˈnɑt ˈteɪk ˈnoʊ ˈfɔːr ˈæn ˈænsɚ/
fixedPhrases.example: She will not take no for an answer when safety is at stake.
fixedPhrases.translation: 事关安全时，她不会接受否定答复。

fixedPhrases.example: No one should be held against their will.
fixedPhrases.translation: 任何人都不应被违背意愿地扣留。

fixedPhrases.example: Users can pause the recording at will.
fixedPhrases.translation: 用户可以随时暂停录音。

fixedPhrases.example: Her strong will to succeed kept her focused through every setback.
fixedPhrases.translation: 强烈的成功意志让她在挫折中仍保持专注。

fixedPhrases.chinese: 在遗嘱中把某物留给他人
fixedPhrases.example: She left the house to her son in her will.
fixedPhrases.translation: 她在遗嘱中把房子留给了儿子。

fixedPhrases.example: He signed the form of his own free will.
Keep the receipt; it will come in handy if you return the item.
fixedPhrases.translation: 留好收据；退货时会用得上。

fixedPhrases.example: A simple email will do for confirmation.
fixedPhrases.translation: 一封简单的电子邮件就足以确认。

synonyms.difference: 常表示已有计划或有当前迹象的预测；will 可表示临时决定。
多用于已有安排或迹象明确的将来事件；will 还可表达临时决定和意愿。
强调主观意图，不用于单纯天气预测或普遍规律。
表示事先安排；will 也可在说话当下才作决定。
只对应 will 的意愿义，不表示一般未来。

antonyms.usage: 只与 will 表示愿意做某事的义项相对；will 说明主动意愿，refuse to 说明明确拒绝该行动。
只与 will 表示出于自主意愿采取行动的义项相对；will 强调本人愿意或决定做，be forced to 表示行动来自外部强制。
只与 will 作名词表示意志和决心的义项相对；a strong will 强调意志坚定＋lack resolve 表示缺乏坚持的决心。

derivatives.note: 不可数名词，指控制冲动或坚持目标的能力。
常用 be willing to do something。
表示不情愿，常接 to do。
说明动作是主动且乐意完成的。
说明虽然做了，但并非出于自愿。

confusables.difference: would 可表示假设、委婉或过去将来；will 通常指真实将来或直接意愿。
will /wɪl/ 是情态动词或名词；well /wɛl/ 是副词或形容词，元音、拼写和句法作用都不同。
